race.comment: Weak maiden. OVERLAND (4) is a 14-start maiden who has five minors to his name, the latest running on hard and missing a nose over 1400m. Is yet to race over the mile for the new yard and returns to the trip overdue and racing well. Gets his chance. ROTH AUTHORITY (6) is another close to a win. Beaten a nose at Cairns two back then a close-up third here last time. Racing well and should feature. SHEFFLIN (8) has had nine runs so far and notched the first minor last time which is encouraging given it was the first try at the mile and a career-best rating. Right in this with a repeat. The race drops right away beyond that. POWER CRUISE (5) is yet to hit the frame in 13 starts but could sneak a place. BUSH ETIQUETTE (2) was fourth last time and can also feature with the right run.
